extracted.intended_audience: Effective Altruism community, potential grant applicants, donors, and researchers interested in long-termist funding (especially AI and bio risk)
extracted.subtask_description: A topic/summary page describing the Long-Term Future Fund (LTFF): an expert-managed EA fund that awards grants aimed at mitigating global catastrophic risks, with particular priority on advanced AI and global catastrophic biological risks. Useful for potential applicants, donors, and community members wanting an overview of the fund's focus and related posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mitigating global catastrophic risks threatening the long-term future
rubrics_metrics.description: The fund is focused on mitigating global catastrophic risks that threaten the long-term future of humanity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority is given to interventions or projects that address risks which could severely harm or truncate humanity's long-term trajectory. (This is the fund's overarching mission/priority as stated on the page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Special focus: risks from advanced artificial intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: The fund has a special focus on risks from advanced artificial intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects addressing AI-related existential or global catastrophic risks are explicitly prioritized by LTFF. (Stated as a primary area of emphasis.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Special focus: global catastrophic biological risks
rubrics_metrics.description: The fund has a special focus on global catastrophic biological risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects addressing biological risks with potential global catastrophic or long-term impacts are explicitly prioritized by LTFF. (Stated as a primary area of emphasis.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert-managed fund
rubrics_metrics.description: The Long-Term Future Fund is an expert-managed fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grant decisions and fund management are carried out by people identified as experts, implying expert assessment and curation of proposals (page states the fund is 'expert-managed').
